answer: Audits are entered in horizon, queued in yarrow, and nebula publishes the wait time. A farm of 280 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 14 identities per epoch. A farm of 1186 identities would post 1144 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
